text:
deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-21_quant-v2 completed -> traffic = 100% (us, eu). canary passed at 09:12 UTC. starting post-deploy smoke run now. 🎯

marta: seeing EU synthetic probe failing at p95 with 5xx surge, started ~09:14 UTC. adding logs. :warning:

aj: can you paste the probe output? which endpoint and model variant?

marta: probe -> /v1/generate (model: quant-v2-eu, route: embed-route). curl snippet:

```
curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \
  -d '{"model":"quant-v2-eu","input":"test"}' | jq -r .error
```

marta: responses show repeated `HTTP/1.1 502` and `upstream connection reset by peer` for ~6 samples. stacktrace from proxy: `net/http: timeout awaiting response`

lee: rolling window looks like a spike during KV-warmup churn. p50 fine, p95 and 5xx up. is this reproduced on us?

marta: US probe fine. spike isolated to eu region (eu1 hosts).

sre-bot: alert created -> INC-2026-03-21-099: eu1 5xx surge. paging oncall. :rotating_light:

aj: two choices: full rollback, or regional pin (route eu -> quant-v1 stable) while we triage quant-v2 in eu. prefer minimal blast radius. thoughts?

lee: regional pin seems low impact. we should also reduce concurrency to avoid cascading connection resets. can we set eu rollout to 0% for quant-v2?

deploy-bot: executing traffic-policy change: set routing for eu model variant to previous version (quant-v1) for 10m hold. command queued by @aj.

marta: confirmed probe back to green after switch (09:18 UTC). p95 dropped to baseline. :relieved:

aj: filing quick release note and changelog entry so support knows we pinned EU to quant-v1. cc @oncall & docs. I'll open a follow-up EPIC to root-cause quant-v2-eu.

lee: next steps: 1) collect model runtime logs from eu1 (kv metrics, smallallocs), 2) run isolated canary of quant-v2 with reduced concurrency + longer warmup, 3) test streaming path for large tokens.

marta: grabbing logs now. here's snippet of proxy errors: `2026-03-21T09:14:22Z ERROR upstream reset after 1m2s idle`

aj: also add a smoke test that exercises prefix cache prefill; suspect quant-v2 changed memory touch pattern and caused host OOM-ish resets under warmup.

deploy-bot: traffic-policy note: eu pinned -> quant-v1 until 2026-03-21T09:28 UTC (auto-unpin disabled). manual unpin required.

lee: good. keep auto-unpin disabled until postmortem. schedule hotpatch if we find a quick fix; otherwise plan a staged re-rollout with telemetry gating.

marta: quick ping — I updated the incident thread with initial logs and a link to the release manifest: https://internal.redwood/sre/releases/2026-03-21_quant-v2 (internal)

aj: thanks. I will draft a short public release note: "EU model traffic temporarily pinned to quant-v1 due to increased 5xx; investigating quant-v2 memory/warmup behavior. We will update in 2h or after root cause."

lee: thumbs up. adding :eyes: reaction.

sre-bot: incident severity -> S2. oncall acknowledged.

marta: will follow up with a triage within 30m. if we find a config/regression we can attempt a hotpatch release targeting eu1 hosts only.

aj: looping in infra owner @lee for kernel/driver check.

lee: got it. I'll look at host-level OOM logs and NIC resets. posting findings in INC-2026-03-21-099.

marta: thanks team. keeping this thread as the coordination channel. :shipit:

(END)
